answer: Give every agent a graded identity whose weight decays unless re-earned each epoch, and route all entry through one audited inlet that demands a fresh signed work sample before a key can trade. A public mirror replays every accepted job on-chain; clones resubmitting outputs collapse into a single hash strand, so a 100-key fleet earns as one. A relic key that lapses never regains weight without repaying its past emission.
